fields.title: Test of Endurance
fields.english:
Grenka was powerful, even by skyborne standards. You should be proud of your accomplishment this day.

During your test of faith you displayed strength of spirit, and now you have shown endurance in battle by taking on the Roguefeather harpies, but the time has come for a new test.

fields.title: Cut Arathor Supply Lines
fields.english: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi.  They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe.  We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.$B$BYou can help us, $n.  Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman.  Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.

fields.title: The Darkreaver Menace
fields.english: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.  Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him.$B$BBring Darkreaver's Head to Eldrun Stormbreaker in the Forlorn Caverns, Ironforge.

source_record.description: Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance.  He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped! This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.$B$BUse the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions.  Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear. $n, bring me his head! Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!

fields.title: The Divination Scryer
fields.english: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

source_record.description:
We now must assemble a Divination Scryer that will be vital for your final trial. The exorcism censer you used in Terrordale is the catalyst for it, and I should be able to fashion a suitable housing for the scrying device.

The last components needed, though, are two diamonds--one white, one black. This represents the duality of our nature as paladins of The Forsaken. These two will be the beacon by which the scryer will pierce the veil between the living and the dead.
source_record.objectivesText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
source_record.title: The Divination Scryer

fields.title: An Epic Ride
fields.english: Inspect the armored riding raptors to choose your epic mount.

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ey, warlock! I must admit I be surprised to see one of your talents here at me stables.

If you are looking for a mount, ya have come to the right place, though they ain't the same as those felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Either way, you're welcome to take a look at our raptors, should ya want one. Most be underestimatin' how intelligent and savage these beasts be. Ya won't be findin' a better, faster or more lethal companion once ya be bonded with it.

Go an' take a look to see if any catch ya interest and return to me when ya made ya choice.

source_record.description:
Ey, $n! Today be a big day for ya, I see. It seems ya be ready to take de reins of our fastest and fiercest raptors. 

Now that you be ridin' a raptor, you know how intelligent and savage these beasts be. I think you be ready for a real raptor now. An armored raptor.

So, you be havin' an important choice to make. Ya raptor and ya will be traversin' the world together, and the raptor will also be needin' to choose ya in return.

Go an' take a look and return ta me when ya made ya choice.
source_record.objectivesText: Inspect the armored riding raptors to choose your epic mount.
source_record.title: An Epic Ride
